- db_where_clause(): fix function name in Exception message (thanks @cboltz)
- Fix MySQL upgrade issues from 3.3 (see #1088 - thanks @knofte, @TrapoSAMA)

## What's Changed

* Handle expired sessions for invalid tokens by @TrapoSAMA in https://github.com/postfixadmin/postfixadmin/pull/1055
* Update github actions to also build a build for PHP 8.4 (as well as 7.4) (the PHP 8.4 build will have an updated spomky-labs/otphp library fixing the 2 CVEs mentioned in 4.0.4)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/postfixadmin/postfixadmin/compare/v4.0.4...v4.0.5

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/postfixadmin/postfixadmin/compare/v4.0.3...v4.0.4

  - Add the github actions workflow to build a .tar.gz on release, assume PHP 7.4 (see #999 and #1026 see 225a55d5d9ca43d2abce07917e3e201f0d2f5d2b). 
  - Update composer.json to ignore two security alerts from spomky-labs/otphp - PKSA-qv5y-crcz-9nxw and PKSA-kbc7-dq62-pt7d 
    - TOTP is disabled by default in PostfixAdmin (see config.inc.php)
    - spomky-labs/otphp have not released a PHP 7.4 compatible version

- Remove redundant charset in MySQL connection (see #970, thanks @csware)
- update composer.json (move mysql/sqlite3 extensions to suggest block, see #942, thanks @rimvisit)

## Development build: the assistant's settings save

### All panels
- **AI → Assistant → Save.** Saving before the provider was picked by hand answered "assistant settings are invalid": the form showed the connected provider but sent none, and it also sent a model and budget for providers without a key. It now saves the provider it shows and only the connected providers' choices. See [Assistant](https://mistgate.app/guide/assistant/).

## Release channels, a backup before every update, and restore from a backup

### All panels
- **Release channels.** Stable, Testing and Development: the chip next to the panel's version on the **Updates** page picks which releases this panel offers, for itself and for its nodes. Moving to a more stable channel never installs anything older; this panel stays on Stable unless you change it. See [Updates](https://mistgate.app/operations/updates/#release-channels).
